summary: 表达假设、愿望、建议等「非真实」情况。核心三种：与现在、过去、将来事实相反。

rules.title: if 虚拟条件句三种基本形态
rules.detail: 与现在相反：If + 过去式（be 用 were），主句 would/could/might + do；与过去相反：If + had done，主句 would have done；与将来相反：If + should/were to do，主句 would do。

examples.en: If I were you, I would take the chance.
examples.zh: 如果我是你，我会抓住机会。（与现在相反）

examples.en: If he had studied harder, he would have passed the exam.
examples.zh: 如果他当时更努力，就能通过考试。（与过去相反）

examples.en: If it were to snow tomorrow, we would cancel the trip.
examples.zh: 如果明天下雪，我们会取消旅行。（与将来相反）

rules.title: wish 后的虚拟
rules.detail: wish + 过去式（现在不可实现的愿望）；wish + had done（过去没实现的遗憾）；wish + would do（希望将来改变）。

examples.en: I wish I were a bird.
She wishes she hadn't said that.
examples.zh: 她真希望自己没说过那话。

rules.title: 建议类虚拟：should + 动词原形（should 可省略）
rules.detail: suggest, insist, demand, require, order, advise 等动词后的宾语从句，以及 It is suggested/important/necessary that... 结构，谓语用 (should) do。

examples.en: The doctor suggested that he (should) rest for a week.
It is necessary that every student (should) master a foreign language.
examples.zh: 每个学生掌握一门外语是必要的。

pitfalls: if 虚拟句中用 will：❌ If I would be you... → ✓ If I were you...
suggest 表「表明」时不用虚拟：The smile suggested that he was satisfied.（真实语气）
混合虚拟：从句过去、主句现在：If I had taken the medicine, I would be fine now.

questions.stem: If I ___ ten years younger, I would learn dancing.
questions.explain: 与现在事实相反的虚拟，be 一律用 were。

questions.stem: If you ___ harder last term, you wouldn't be so worried now.
questions.explain: 从句与过去相反用 had studied；主句与现在相反 would be（混合虚拟）。

questions.stem: I wish I ___ how to swim, but I don't.
questions.explain: wish 后与现在相反用过去式 knew。

questions.stem: It is required that every member ___ the meeting.
questions.explain: It is required that 后用 (should) + 动词原形，should 省略后为 attend。

questions.stem: If he ___ (take) my advice, he wouldn't have failed the interview.
questions.explain: 与过去事实相反的虚拟条件句：If + had done。

questions.stem: The teacher insisted that the homework ___ (hand) in before Friday.
questions.explain: insist 表「坚决要求」时从句用 (should) + 动词原形；作业是被交，用 be handed。

questions.stem: If it will snow tomorrow, we would stay at home.
questions.answer: will snow → snowed / were to snow / should snow
questions.explain: 与将来相反的虚拟条件句用过去式（snowed）、were to do 或 should do。

questions.stem: 要是当时有你的帮助，我就不会成功了。（翻译整句，without 也可以）
answer: without your help, i couldn't have succeeded.
if it hadn't been for your help, i couldn't have succeeded.
but for your help, i couldn't have succeeded.
questions.explain: without/but for 短语可代替虚拟条件句；对过去的虚拟主句用 couldn't have done。

questions.stem: 我倒希望你更细心一些。（翻译整句，wish）
answer: i wish you were more careful.
questions.explain: wish 后与现在相反，be 一律用 were。
